clean_description: In "Imago," the Oankali, alien genetic traders, view humanity as a genetic failure and have taken away their ability to reproduce. The first constructed beings, hybrids of Oankali and humans, struggle to mediate between the two species. Jodahs, the first constructed Ooloi, possesses the ability to heal genetically and seeks to help humans overcome their deep-seated fear and hatred of the alien presence, using his unique gifts to bridge the gap between the two races.
